Taylor (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A  capturing a couple of live questions on promotions, comp notes, and handbook timing. dropping answers here. :wave:
Chris (Eng Manager): thx. if a hiring manager promises a 6-month promotion during offers, does that automatically change comp?
Taylor (People Ops): short: no automatic comp change. managers should document an "Onboarding Promotion Plan" in the offer notes and submit a promotion packet at the agreed time. approvals follow normal calibration and budget checks.
Nadia (IC): can we get the exact 1-line copy for offers so recruiters can paste it?
Taylor (People Ops): paste this: "Onboarding Promotion Plan: target review at 6 months; success criteria attached; manager & peer reviewer named; promotion subject to calibration and budget approval."
Sam (Recruiting): noted  i'll add to the offer playbook and use verbatim.
payroll-bot: FYI: salary changes are effective on the first payroll after HR approval. retro-pay requires finance sign-off.
Taylor (People Ops): also: transfers keep original review windows by default. if scope changes materially, request a transfer recalibration (both managers + People Ops sign-off).
Chris (Eng Manager): appeals timeline again?
Taylor (People Ops): appeals window is 14 calendar days after the calibration email. managers file packets for direct reports; ICs should talk to their manager first. we'll publish the handbook snippet by end of next week. :calendar:
